active_ingredient: Active Ingredient Purpose Ethyl Alcohol 62.0% ................. Antimicrobial
purpose: Uses for handwashing to decrease bacteria on the skin recommended for repeated use
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a poison control center right away.
indications_and_usage: XtraCare® Kills 99.9% of germs Instant Hand Sanitizer with moisturizers cucumber melon scent 8 FL OZ / 237 mL
dosage_and_administration: Directions wet hands thoroughly with product briskly rub hands together until dry supervise children under 6 years in the use of this product
warnings: Warnings For external use only Flammable, keep away from heat and flame. Do not use in the eyes. In case of contact, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation and redness develop and persist for more than 72 hours.
